title: Toxopid's Legs are Flexible and crush the Units they land on
notes: S+ #121.1 Toxopid Leg gains Flexible. S+ #121 Toxopid's Cry draws its Legs' zones from every unit and backrow zone of both sides (Radiant: the opponent's) that holds nothing or only Units, destroys the Units there, and lands a Leg in each zone once the deaths resolve (R5048000).

player.title: Toxopid's Legs crush what they land on
changes: Toxopid Leg is now Flexible, so it can stand in the backrow as well as the unit row.
Toxopid's Legs now land in random zones of either row, empty or holding Units, and destroy the Units there before they land.
Radiant Toxopid's Legs still land only on your opponent's side, now in either row, destroying the Units there.
